status: DRAFT for owner review, not frozen. No SEC request, sample draw, exhibit read or 10-Q value projection has been made. Freezing needs the owner's decisions listed under open_decisions; the SEC requests need separate owner approval.
question: For a seeded random sample of strategy-qualified 10-Q events whose only Item 2.02 8-K maps to an earlier decision session, does that 8-K's original press-release exhibit state the same S and Q input values, for the same periods, that the later 10-Q reports?
why: Both metadata audits found an earlier Item 2.02 8-K for most 10-Qs (disclosure-timing20261001: 63.9-64.4% of qualified events by decision session; disclosure-novelty20261001: 2,484 of 4,057 originals by ET date). Timing does not show content. Only a component shown to be stated in the earlier release may ever move to the earlier clock.

S.definition: (current-quarter net income - prior-year same-quarter net income) / prior fiscal-year-end total assets, standardized by the issuer's previous eight innovations (unchanged)

Q.definition: ((current YTD operating cash flow - current YTD net income) - (prior-year YTD operating cash flow - prior-year YTD net income)) / prior fiscal-year-end total assets

components.note: The S history of eight earlier innovations was already public through earlier 10-Qs and is not probed.

release_sets.reason: Prior fiscal-year-end total assets were normally public earlier through the prior annual report, like the eight historical S innovations. The verdict therefore uses the flow components; assets are reported separately as stated or not stated in the release. A later full extraction must bind assets to the earlier annual filing's verified clock and value; this probe does not fetch annual reports.

population.rule: strategy_source_qualified is true and status is single_prior
population.excluded: multiple (which release applies is ambiguous), single_same_session (no earlier session), single_after, no_candidate and window_coverage_incomplete

sample.order: ascending SHA256 of the UTF-8 string 'exhibit-content20261002|' + 10-Q accession number; take the first 150
sample.replacement: none: a failed fetch, missing exhibit, identity failure or unmatched value stays in the sample and its denominator

requests.archive: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/{issuer CIK as an integer, no leading zeros}/{8-K accession without dashes}/ — the frozen capture's archive_base rule, keyed by the issuer CIK. 402 of the 1,166 frame 8-Ks were filed by an agent whose CIK is the accession prefix, so the prefix must never be used.
per_event: every document whose index type starts with EX-99, in index order, at most 10; an index with more than 10 fetches none of them and the event is exhibit_overflow
requests.redirects: none; a redirect is saved as a failure
requests.user_agent: Reuse the frozen capture's user agent unless the owner supplies a contact address (see open_decisions)
never: images, XBRL or any non-EX-99 document
prices, returns, forecasts or account ledgers

storage: Every response's exact bytes under source/raw/<sha256>.bin, referenced from the request journal, following the frozen capture convention.

rules: header filer CIK equals the issuer CIK
header item information includes Results of Operations and Financial Condition (Item 2.02) when the header lists items
header acceptance time re-clocked with the frozen event_clock must still give a decision session strictly earlier than the 10-Q's
identity_checks.failure: Any failed check keeps the event in the sample as identity_failed or header_not_prior and it counts as not stated

comparison_values.projection: Only the components' value fields, their period endpoints and prior_fy_end, for the 150 sampled accessions, written to a committed projection file that records the source SHA256. No other field, price, return, forecast or account is read.
comparison_values.q_unavailable: A sampled event without a qualified Q keeps its S comparison; its Q components are reported as not_comparable and it leaves the Q denominator only in a separately reported row

matching.tables: HTML tables parsed with the standard-library HTML parser, with colspan expanded. A row is a header row when every cell after its label cell is empty or holds only period text: a year from 1990 to 2039, a month or month-day, or a duration or 'ended' phrase. Header rows end at the first row whose label cell is non-empty and that holds a numeric cell that is not a lone year; split rows such as 'Three Months Ended June 30,' followed by '2025 | 2024' therefore both stay in the header. Each value cell inherits the combined header text of its column. The table caption and nearest preceding heading are kept as context.
matching.plain_text: Lines split on two or more spaces into a label and value columns; the header is the nearest preceding line without numeric values
matching.numbers: Commas removed; parentheses or a leading minus mean negative; a dash alone means zero; footnote markers ignored
matching.scale: 1, 1e3, 1e6 or 1e9; an 'in thousands/millions/billions' phrase in the caption, context or header fixes the scale
matching.tolerance: half a unit of the displayed precision at that scale

labels.operating_cash_flow: net cash (provided by|used in|provided by \(used in\)|from) operating activities|cash flows? from operating activities

matching.labels_note: Case-insensitive searches over the row's label cell text after whitespace is collapsed

periods.durations: three months, quarter or 12-14 weeks = 3; six months or 25-27 weeks = 6; nine months or 38-40 weeks = 9; twelve months, year or 51-53 weeks = 12
periods.end_dates: month-day-year, month-year, or a year combined with a month-day phrase elsewhere in the same header, caption or context

required.current_ni: 3-month duration ending within 7 days of current_end
required.prior_ni: 3-month duration ending within 7 days of prior_end
required.q_current_cfo / q_current_ni: year-to-date duration (3, 6 or 9 months matching the 10-Q) ending within 7 days of q_current_end
required.q_prior_cfo / q_prior_ni: same duration ending within 7 days of q_prior_end
required.prior_fy_assets: an instant column dated within 7 days of prior_fy_end

matching.rule: A component is stated only when a table cell or narrative sentence, under a label that matches its pattern and none of the exclusions, equals the 10-Q value within the tolerance AND its column header or sentence parses to the required period. An equal value whose period does not parse is period_unverified; an equal value under a different parsed period does not count.
matching.evidence: Exhibit SHA256, table and row index, label text, cell text, header text, parsed period and scale for every match
matching.narrative: Text outside tables is split into sentences. A sentence counts as evidence for a component when it contains the component's label (subject to the exclusions), a number equal to the 10-Q value (with a currency symbol and an optional 'thousand', 'million' or 'billion' word setting the scale) and a period phrase in the same sentence (for example 'three months ended June 30, 2024', 'second quarter of 2024', 'first half', 'year to date'). The period phrase must parse to the required period, else the match is period_unverified.
matching.currency: A leading or trailing $, US$ or USD is removed and recorded in the evidence. A cell or sentence marked with any other currency (C$, CAD, EUR, GBP, the euro or pound sign) is never compared, because the 10-Q values are USD, and is recorded as currency_mismatch
matching.label_exclusions: A label also matching adjusted, non-GAAP, pro forma, core, excluding, before, per share, margin or noncontrolling (case-insensitive) never counts for a component, so an adjusted or per-share figure that equals the GAAP value cannot make it stated
matching.specification: This prose specifies the rules. At freeze, the implementation and a synthetic fixture for every rule (split header rows, currency marks, adjusted labels, narrative sentences, image dependence, period mismatches) are bound by SHA256 and define them exactly; the 20-event spot check then reports any disagreement with a human reading

classification: exhibit_unavailable (unsupported_format, image_dependent, exhibit_overflow, release_unidentified or fetch failure)

statistics.per_signal: share with every S_flow component stated, and with every Q_flow component stated; assets reported separately
statistics.bounds: lower counts period_unverified, currency_mismatch, exhibit_unavailable, identity_failed, header_not_prior and release_ambiguous as not stated; upper counts period_unverified, currency_mismatch, exhibit_unavailable and release_ambiguous as stated (identity_failed and header_not_prior stay not stated: the filing is not an earlier same-issuer release)

interpretation.per_signal: For S_flow and Q_flow separately: release_complete_common if the Wilson lower limit of the lower-bound share is at least 0.7; release_complete_rare if the Wilson upper limit of the upper-bound share is below 0.3; otherwise inconclusive
interpretation.common: Justifies only a separately declared full-population extraction of that signal's components from the releases
interpretation.never: No verdict backdates a 10-Q value, changes a completed result, promotes a strategy or implies profitability

verification: Offline synthetic tests of fetch bounds, index/header parsing, number parsing, scaling, tolerance and classification before any request; after the run, an independent checker re-derives every classification from the saved bytes; a seeded list of 20 events with their evidence for an owner spot check
open_decisions: Population: decision-session single_prior qualified events (1,166) as drafted, or also the novelty audit's pairs

Sample size: 150. Each event needs 3 or more requests (index, header and every EX-99 document); typical filings have one or two EX-99 documents, so expect about 450-600 requests (8-10 minutes at 1 request per second), with a hard cap of 1,800
Where to run: the owner's workstation, or this cloud container if its network policy allows www.sec.gov (checking that is itself an SEC request)
10-Q comparison values: records.json (208 MB) is not in the clone; either run the projection on the workstation and commit its output, or upload a gzip copy split into parts under 10 MB
User agent: reuse the frozen no-contact agent or add a contact address, which SEC fair-access guidance asks for

locks: exclusive study lock .qualification/exhibit-content20261002/probe.lock.sqlite, held for the whole attempt
exclusive writer transaction on the shared .qualification/earnings-quality20260928/sec-source.lock.sqlite, so no other SEC source worker runs at the same time
before starting or resuming, inspect owned processes and both locks; a held lock or a live owned process refuses the start
lifecycle.attempt: One attempt per frozen definition, identified by a new UUID under attempts/<uuid>/. attempt.json records the definition SHA256, code SHA256s, runtime and status and is replaced atomically. A failed attempt is kept; a new attempt for the same definition needs a declared amendment.
lifecycle.journal: attempts/<uuid>/requests.sqlite is append-only. A 'started' row (URL, time) is committed before each request; a 'completed' row (status, byte count, SHA256 or failure) is committed only after the response bytes are fsynced under source/raw/<sha256>.bin.
lifecycle.resume: Only the same attempt may resume, after the lock and process checks pass. A URL with a completed row is never requested again, whatever its status. A URL with a started row and no completed row may be requested once more; both starts count toward every cap, and a second interruption records it as failed.

documents.supported: HTML (by .htm/.html name or an <html>/<table> sniff) and plain text (.txt)
documents.unsupported: PDF (%PDF), images and any other binary are exhibit_unavailable (unsupported_format)
documents.image_dependent: Per component, not per document. A component that is not stated is exhibit_unavailable (image_dependent) when the document has an whose alt text, file name or nearest preceding heading names the statement that would hold it (income or operations statement for net income, cash flow statement for operating cash flow, balance sheet for assets). A logo or any other image does not change not_found.
documents.press_release: Press-release candidates are fetched EX-99 documents whose index description, or whose first 3,000 characters of text, match (press|news|earnings) release case-insensitively. Exactly one candidate is the release. With none, the single EX-99.1 is used and flagged release_by_type; with no single EX-99.1 the event is release_unidentified (unavailable). With several, all candidates are matched jointly and the event is flagged release_ambiguous.
documents.secondary: Availability in any fetched EX-99 document is reported as a separate, non-verdict readout

runtime.python: 3.13, with pyproject.toml and uv.lock bound by SHA256 at freeze
runtime.clock: The decision session comes from event_clock in .qualification/filing-features20260928/features.py (SHA256 991260b80547c03c873c0d5bf62c57d86bf3fc1f5c0df0c192a7b4cc1fcc372f), loaded only from those verified bytes
runtime.calendar: .qualification/post-filing-strategy20260928/calendar.json (SHA256 a1ead37ff8a7696fd503d0f5eb8c97c99d833be5e9ef3c17c487e610fb5d2560), the same XNYS calendar the completed study and the decision-session audit used
runtime.tzdata: zoneinfo's search path is reset so America/New_York resolves only from the uv.lock-pinned tzdata 2026.4 package; the installed version must equal it, and the attempt records the America/New_York TZif SHA256 (the decision-session audit recorded d7f2206b3a45989fc9ad63d558922532fa7352280d5f87176bf1db79cb1d1fa9)
runtime.check: Each sampled 10-Q's decision session is recomputed with these bindings and must equal its q_entry_session in the decision-session audit's events.json, or the attempt stops before any request
recorded_per_attempt: tzdata version and America/New_York TZif SHA256
every bound code and input SHA256
